metadata.case_name: CHAN YUK MEI AND OTHERS v. LAW WAI CHUEN

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: intended to become a clerk at an office
plaintiff.education_level: left school at age 15 whilst attending Form 2

injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: bruising and haematoma over the face
source: bruising and haematoma over the face
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: a subtrochanteric fracture of the right hip
source: a subtrochanteric fracture of the right hip

injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of hip or thigh, unspecified

source: treatment to the fracture of the nasal bone

manifestations.description: extensive scarring to the scalp, face and right thigh
a small surgical scar at the neck
restriction in movement of right leg
limping would occur after sitting or standing for a long time or after walking for a long distance
changed from a sporty, active and cheerful teenager to a dull, asocial and depressed young lady with suicidal tendency
chronic dermatitis on the right thigh
spatial perception problem "likely to be permanent and interfere with the development of skills such as driving, manipulating machinery or copying"
ability to concentrate and apply herself for reasonable periods is still low
mood is unstable and describes the typical affective swings characteristic of post head-injury disability
afraid of venturing out alone except in a very limited locale; virtually housebound for a considerable period
psychologically dependent on her husband and friends to go out
depressed, suffering from anxiety and irritability and had become suicidal

treatments_received: right leg tibial traction with a Steinmann's pin
insertion of an angled plate into the right hip approximating the fractured neck of the femur with a long extension of the plate into the shaft of the femur
removal of a piece of glass from the right eyelid
surgery to improve scars at the neck and eyelids
treatment of inflammation to the surgical wound in the right thigh
treatments_future: fixed-fixed gold-bonded porcelain bridge prosthesis to replace the removable denture (for loss of 2 upper teeth)
plastic surgery to eyelid and nose

losses.description: extensive scarring to the scalp, face and right thigh; a small surgical scar at the neck; deformity of the nose
restriction in movement of right leg; limping after sitting or standing for a long time or after walking for a long distance

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: was a sporty teenager (played volleyball and organ) and can no longer participate as before
ability to concentrate and apply herself for reasonable periods is still low; spatial perception problem likely to be permanent

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: afraid of venturing out alone except in a very limited locale; virtually housebound for a considerable period; psychologically dependent on others to go out
changed from a sporty, active and cheerful teenager to a dull, asocial and depressed young lady with suicidal tendency
the boyfriend she was seeing prior to the accident had since disappeared; loss of previous social life

losses.category: Loss of ability to give birth
losses.description: she will have difficulties in giving birth to children
